name: jarus
author: pazitiv4ik@users.noreply.github.com
description: Nginx + PHP 8.1-8.4 + Node. On boot it also starts Yarus WMS: the built site on the server port and the API on 127.0.0.1:$YARUS_API_PORT (default 3001) with a SQLite file in yarus/data. Docker image: ghcr.io/pazitiv4ik/nestcp-webhost:latest

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null
apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates tar >/dev/null
cd /mnt/server
REPO="${GIT_REPO:-}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
TOKEN="${GIT_TOKEN:-}"
mkdir -p www/default/public_html logs run tmp/jobs tmp/client_body tmp/proxy tmp/fastcgi nginx/conf.d php-fpm bin ssl
if [ -z "$REPO" ]; then
  echo "GIT_REPO is empty — volume dirs only. Set GIT_REPO to https://github.com/USER/REPO"
  exit 0
fi
REPO="${REPO%.git}"
REPO="${REPO%/}"
if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
  ARCHIVE_URL="$(echo "$REPO" | sed "s#https://github.com/#https://x-access-token:${TOKEN}@github.com/#")/archive/refs/heads/${BRANCH}.tar.gz"
else
  ARCHIVE_URL="${REPO}/archive/refs/heads/${BRANCH}.tar.gz"
fi
echo "Fetching ${ARCHIVE_URL}"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
curl -fsSL -o "$TMP/src.tgz" "$ARCHIVE_URL"
tar -xzf "$TMP/src.tgz" -C "$TMP"
SKEL="$(find "$TMP" -type d -name skel | head -n 1)"
if [ -z "$SKEL" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: no skel/ in repo. Upload egg/ as the GitHub repo root."
  exit 1
fi
cp -a "$SKEL/start.sh" /mnt/server/start.sh
cp -a "$SKEL/bin/." /mnt/server/bin/ 2>/dev/null || true
cp -a "$SKEL/nginx/nginx.conf" /mnt/server/nginx/nginx.conf 2>/dev/null || true
[ -f /mnt/server/sites.json ] || cp -a "$SKEL/sites.json" /mnt/server/sites.json 2>/dev/null || true
[ -f /mnt/server/www/default/public_html/index.php ] || cp -a "$SKEL/www/default/public_html/index.php" /mnt/server/www/default/public_html/index.php 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -d "$SKEL/yarus/backend" ] && [ ! -f /mnt/server/yarus/backend/package.json ]; then mkdir -p /mnt/server/yarus; cp -a "$SKEL/yarus/backend" /mnt/server/yarus/backend; fi
if [ -d "$SKEL/yarus/web" ]; then mkdir -p /mnt/server/www/yarus/public_html/assets; rm -f /mnt/server/www/yarus/public_html/assets/index-*.js /mnt/server/www/yarus/public_html/assets/index-*.css; cp -a "$SKEL/yarus/web/." /mnt/server/www/yarus/public_html/; fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
echo "NestCP files installed from ${REPO}@${BRANCH}"

variables.name: GitHub repo
variables.description: Public repo URL. Upload the egg/ folder as the repository root.

variables.name: GitHub token
variables.description: Only for a private repository. Leave empty if the repo is public.

variables.name: Auto-update on start
variables.description: 1 = re-download start.sh/nginx/bin from GitHub on every start. 0 = only if files are missing. Never overwrites www/.

variables.name: Yarus API port
variables.description: Внутренний порт API Яруса. Снаружи сайт открывается на порту сервера, nginx отправляет /api сюда. По умолчанию 3001. Не ставьте порт, совпадающий с портом сервера.
